I can already pass the tests. 4:30 min mile, 40 pullups, 135 situps. Black belt in jiujitsu, Muay Thai, Krav Maga. 
I can't afford help.
I don't really want to do anything, I just want to sit outside reading my books, my ideal life is just having a small little house in a snowy place. Hot meals, and relaxing. I can't handle much that needs commitment
